children: Spectral posted an investor presentation highlighting FDA De Novo clearance, BARDA funding and near-term commercial launch plans.
Posted investor presentation on website and furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K; will use in investor and analyst presentations.
FDA granted De Novo classification May 21, 2026, authorizing commercial sales in the U.S.
BARDA supports procurement of up to 30 DeepView systems; $150M total contract with $86.6M committed to date.
Balance sheet at June 30, 2026: $14.0M cash, $19.4M total assets, $31.5M total liabilities, $12.1M stockholders' deficit.
Company targets first commercial sales by year-end 2026 and planned BARDA-subsidized deployments through June 2027.

title: Spectral posts investor presentation after FDA De Novo clearance, details BARDA-funded commercial launch
